First-Principles Investigation of the Structural and Electronic Properties of Two-Dimensional (MoWVNbTa)S₂

With Allan Abraham B. Padama

A first-principles study of a two-dimensional material with five transition metals. Explore the atomic model, electronic bands, charge redistribution and density of states in a visual research showcase.
